target_customer: Consumers new to Ethereum who want a friendly mobile wallet to hold tokens, NFTs and use decentralized apps; later retail traders
problem: Crypto wallets were utilitarian and hard for newcomers, especially on mobile.
business_model: Free self custody wallet monetized through swap fees and later trading products and a token (RNBW) with a paid tier

founders.name: Christian Baroni
founders.background_notes: A profile found via search says he worked as a freelance UI designer for clients including Groupon, Stripe and Microsoft; not opened directly, so not listed as employers.

founders.name: Jin Chung
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on YC page; no background found.

founders.name: Michael Demarais
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on YC page and quoted by TechCrunch in 2022; no background found.

competitors.name: MetaMask
competitors.what: Browser based Ethereum wallet and dapp gateway from ConsenSys, with a mobile app released in July 2019

competitors.name: imToken
competitors.what: Ethereum mobile wallet launched in 2016, mostly used in China and Asia
competitors.traction_then: Interview in July 2019 cites a peak of 7M monthly active users

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile wallet needs secure key handling, Ethereum node and token integrations and swaps; standard crypto engineering with security risk, built by a small team of designers and engineers in 2019.

defensibility.rationale: Wallet code is open source and users can import seed phrases from other wallets, so switching is easy; the main differentiator is design and brand.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet and others stayed larger; by late 2021 MetaMask had over 21 million monthly users per TechCrunch. No incumbent acquired Rainbow in sources found.

market_need_then: In 2019 Ethereum wallets for mobile were scarce and technical; the 2022 TechCrunch article describes the new wave of consumer friendly wallets and rapid growth in wallet users, but 2019 demand evidence is thin.

identity.visual_style: Playful and consumer oriented with rainbow colored buttons and emojis, per TechCrunch 2022
identity.voice_and_tone: Fun and friendly, positioned as making Ethereum fun and accessible

branding.brand_signature: Rainbow colored playful interface and the collectible app icons feature
branding.community_and_virality: Company site links a collectible app icons page and media kit; 2025 coverage shows an active token community, but fan or meme evidence for the early period was not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Press describes Rainbow as Ethereum's hippest wallet app and design led, which likely helped consumer appeal, but the name is generic and no source ties growth to the brand directly.

pivots.to: Multi market trading app covering crypto, predictions and perps with a RNBW token
pivots.why: Not stated in the sources opened; the company site now describes trading of any market.

outcome_analysis: Rainbow built a design led Ethereum mobile wallet, raised a small seed and an 18 million dollar Series A in 2021 led by Seven Seven Six, and is still operating with 28 people. It competes with much larger wallets such as MetaMask and later widened into trading and a token. Evidence points to a strong consumer design position rather than a hard moat, and the later trading pivot suggests the wallet alone was not enough.
notes: Series A of 18M and seed of 1.5M are stated by TechCrunch, The Block and Decrypt (investor lists come from ForkLog; Decrypt said none were disclosed, so the list is partly single source). TechCrunch says the round closed in October 2021 and was announced February 2022. Seedtable shows a separate October 2021 Series A that looks like a duplicate. Seed date and investors not found. Rainbow's Medium launch post returned 403 and was not read. Competitor sources: MetaMask mobile July 2019 and imToken July 2019 interview; MetaMask article date approximated from the July 2019 launch it describes. The September 2025 Clanker acquisition proposal failed and is recorded here only as news. Pivot date is approximate.
